label: Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics I.1… supports A thing is GOOD_4 in a given perfection…
note: Nicomachean Ethics I.1 is the authority Aquinas cites for the ratio boni in ST I q.5 a.1 co. It says that the good is what all things aim at, of the ends of arts and actions; it does not state the per-perfection biconditional, so it supports the statement without stating it.
